There is NO ring beam east of grid4: at row E the beam stops dead at the grid4 column, and at rows D-C the thin single line running out to the 4' line is the SY slab-edge outline of the landing platform, not a beam (real beams on this sheet are drawn as double lines with hatched column nodes). The row C-B interior span (through unsupported grid3, matching the floor-beam sheets' pattern) is assumed to bear through rather than split at grid3, consistent with S-04/S-05's confirmed C2-C4 spans — not independently re-verified against a footing/column check specific to this roof level (there are no footings at truss-bearing height by definition; carried the floor-plan support pattern forward as the best available basis).

Four short RC roof struts marked 'CX' sit off the main beam grid (see grid master dummy lines D'/D"/C'/C" and 1"/2') — per S-09's note these rise from the ring-beam level up to the roof structure (roof strut/king-post), not primary framing. The interior RB2 that carries the two southern CX posts IS now recorded (C1"-B1", placed by the sheet's own printed 2.00 offset from grid1); the shorter stubs feeding the northern pair at D'2'/D"2' are still not itemised individually.

The interior grid2 line carries a full RB1 from row E right down to row B (three segments) and row B has an RB2 running east to grid4 — all four were missing from an earlier pass, which recorded only the outer perimeter loop plus the grid1/grid4 verticals.
